units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:5">Cant. R. to IV, 5</cite> there were two families &c. <he>אחת מֵיקֶרֶת וכ׳</he> (not <he>מקרית</he>) one was cold-blooded &c., v. <cite ref="T01122"><he>רָתַח</he></cite>
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 23:5">Num. R. s. 23</cite> <he>כאן … הוּקַרְנוּ</he> here we slept, here we felt cold.

senses.gloss: to be cooled off; (with דעת) to be pacified, feel satisfied.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 2">Num. R. s. 2</cite> <he>נ׳ בצילו</he> he cooled himself in its shade.—
<cite ref="Yevamot 63a:5">Yeb. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>ולא נִתְקָרְרָה דעתו עד וכ׳</he> and he found no satisfaction until &c.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14">Num. R. s. 14</cite>, beg. <he>ולא נתקררה דעתו</he> and he (the Lord) was not pacified. Tanḥ. Vaëthḥ. 6 <he>באותה שעה נתקררה רוח הקדש</he> that moment the divine spirit was cooled off (from its anger); a. e.—V. <cite ref="S00585"><he>קוֹרָה</he> II</cite>.
